sources.entry: Dropover - Temporary shelf for collecting and moving dragged files, text, and links. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dropover-easier-drag-drop/id1355679052?platform=mac)

summary.name: Dropover
summary.one_liner: Dropover is a Mac drag-and-drop utility that collects dragged files, links, text, and images on a temporary floating shelf so you can move, share, or process them together.
use_cases: collect files from several windows before moving them together
run repetitive file tasks with custom actions or instant actions
share files by uploading them to a cloud link
auto-open a shelf when files land in a watched folder
trigger file actions from Alfred or Raycast
summary.what_it_does: Dropover opens a temporary shelf on macOS when you shake the pointer, drop files on the menu bar icon, or drop onto the notch. Shelves hold files, links, text, and images, which can be previewed with Quick Look, renamed, reordered, or removed. Dropping items on Instant Actions or custom actions runs tasks such as scripts (AppleScript, Automator, UNIX tools). Dragged content can also be uploaded to the cloud, optionally with a title, password, expiration date, or link type, and the uploads can be viewed or deleted from the menu bar or Preferences.
notable: Shake pointer, menu bar, or notch to open a shelf, with pinned and recent shelves
Custom scripts and actions via AppleScript, Automator, UNIX tools, plus Siri Shortcuts, Alfred and Raycast extensions
Anonymous cloud upload with shareable links, password, and expiration options
caveats: Platform list names macOS; the page only mentions iOS in the App Store link context, so iOS support is not confirmed by the page text
Pricing is not stated on the page beyond the cloud upload being described as free
Recent shelves are limited to reopening up to 10 previously closed shelves
